correctness.rationale: The bijection tracks unique retained permutation cycles, cycle-phase maps, one idempotent local map per retained cycle and image-constrained maps on omitted cycles. Each retained cycle contributes its length times local rank to the image, so coefficient counting is exact. The least-rank theorem follows from divisibility-minimal occurring cycle lengths and a forced-representative argument. The packaged checker directly checks function composition and symmetry in 15 independent finite enumerations.

Existing full-partition idempotent enumerations and permutation cycle-divisibility theorems are used as prior ingredients. value.rationale: It determines the complete image-size stratification of idempotents in the fixed-unit centralizer of a classical imprimitive transformation monoid, for all block sizes and block-cycle types. The exact divisibility-minimal rank and the multiplicity of minimizers demonstrate an obstruction invisible in unsymmetrized total counts. It is a natural complete parameterized invariant of retractions under symmetry, not an arbitrary numeric subcase.
